dataList.content:
<Ah, the dungeon...>
<啊，迷宫……>
dataList.place:
Mirror Dungeon of the Fathoms
心象镜像迷宫

dataList.content:
After a grueling battle, and as we finally managed to drag Bamboo-hatted Kim to his knees...
激烈的战斗终于结束，金笠跪倒在地……

Like a mirage, the fathoms of ego began to fall apart.
如同海市蜃楼消散一般，心象的形态逐渐崩溃。
dataList.place:
Yong-jin Building 6F Office
龙进大楼 6层 办公室

dataList.content:
The Monolith had already left the Fathoms of Ego and was back at the center of the office.
原本在那内部的独石不知何时也从心象中抽离，出现在办公室中央。

Just as the office began to resemble the one we had walked into, the radio I carried began to buzz again.
正当我们所处的办公室几乎恢复原状的时候，我又听见怀里传来的沙沙声。

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Hiya! Can you hear me? If you do, gimme a 'tick-tock'!
啊！听得见吗？听到的话就滴答两声！

<Tick-tock.>
<……滴答。>

Very funny, Dante. You know we just barely survived a deadly encounter, right?
刚刚才经历过一场苦战，真亏你还能这样开玩笑啊，但丁。

Well, she asked me to...
人家让我滴答两声我才滴答的……

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Perfect! We really don't have much time left. Since it looks like the Monolith's briefly stabilized, lemme teach you how to lock it down.
好！这次真的没多少时间了。独石看上去也暂时稳定下来了。我要说关闭它的方法啦！

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Don't take too long, or that Distortion's gonna turn into an Abnormality! Follow my instructions to a T, and don't lag behind! It's all about precision and speed!
要是没来得及，那个扭曲就会变成异想体。所以要准确、迅速地解决。明白吗？

She seems awfully cheerful for how, uh, dire the situation is...
怎么好像轻描淡写地说出了非常恐怖的情况……

I followed the radio's instructions and reached out to the Monolith with my palms.
我听从对讲机里传来的指示，向独石伸出手。

<Ooh... some light came out of it when I reached out with my fingers.>
<哦……手指一靠近就好像有什么光冒出来了……>

The voice coming from the radio was pretty nonchalant about all this, but it almost sounded like she could see exactly what I was looking at.
对讲机里的声音毫不慌张，好像能准确看到我的手现在碰到哪里了似的。

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Right, straight down from there. Yep, you're doing good. Now move left... take it slow, now.
从那儿向下划……嗯，现在往左慢慢移动。

I couldn't help but wonder if I was doing this right... but I still followed her directions and drew a trail of light with my hand over the Monolith.
我一边担心自己做的是否正确，一边在独石上划出一道光痕。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage Mentor
剑契组 头领
dataList.content:
Aagh...
啊……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Mentor!
金笠大人！

The shimmering black tendrils began to withdraw from Bamboo-hatted Kim's body. Maybe the Distortion is withdrawing, too...?
也许是因为扭曲状态被解除，金笠身上晃动着的黑色东西也消失了。

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Good work! Detective, the levels are stabilizing!
好，数值……回到稳定范围内了，侦探大人！

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Ah, I can't seem to stop calling you Detective, huh. Sorry, old habits die hard, y'know...
啊，又叫成侦探大人了……这称呼都成习惯了。

Sounds like she's reporting to someone else on the other side of this communication.
很显然，对讲机那头的人是在对我以外的某个人汇报。

dataList.title:
LCD?
LCD？
dataList.content:
Good work, bus dudes! LCA'll be there in a min, so just sit tight!
做得好，巴士的各位！LCA马上就到了所以稍安勿躁哦！

<Huh? LCA? Not that rude After Team lady from earlier...?>
<嗯？LCA？就是刚刚那个说话带刺的收尾部队的……>

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Well, anyways! Thanks for the assist, everyone! LCD Distortion Task Force Ezra, over and out!
嘛，总而言之！这里是LCD所属扭曲专案组的以斯拉！通讯结束！

The radio shut off before any of us had the chance to say anything. Again.
对讲机再次发出哔哔的声音，单方面切断了。

And not 5 seconds later...
随后还没过5秒……

My, my! They're really piling in, huh?
天啊，他们怎么来这么快？！

LCA... the special operations unit.
是LCA……特殊作战小组。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Orders. Commencing secured item retrieval.
命令。回收保护物品。

<Uh, right. The item is—>
<啊，物品在……>

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Custody Target T-276 confirmed and secured.
已确认监管目标T-276。立即保护。

<Well, looks like our job here is done.>
<他们自己看着办了。>

I didn't even have to say anything (not that they could hear me, anyway) before the uniformed troops marched in and started attaching various tools to the Monolith.
我还没说什么（反正他们也听不见），有着惊人相似外表的他们就开始咔嗒咔嗒地把各种装置放到独石上。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Trouble. T-276-01 unconfirmed. Requesting location.
疑问。T-276-01在哪里。

What are you blathering about?
什么意思？

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
... Rewording. Where is the Distorted individual?
……更换。扭曲个体在哪里。

Ah, I am aware of whom you seek. He sits next to the Monolith—
啊，他就在独石侧边……

Huh? W-where hast he gone?
嗯？那、那人去何处了？

The individual by the name Aeng-du dragged him behind that sofa. Approximate time of event: three minutes ago. 
大约3分钟前，我看见名为樱桃的人将他拖至沙发后方。

<... Didn't I ask you to tell us if you notice something important going on in the background...?>
<我记得自己说过希望你一看到特殊情况就能告诉我们……>

... I will make an immediate report should an identical incident occur.
……如果再发生类似情况我会立刻汇报。

That's when I noticed that the LCA agents were growing visibly uneasy.
这时，我看见LCA的员工在沙发旁犹豫的样子。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Alert. Abnormal reaction detected from an entity in T-276-01's proximity.
警报。接近T-276-01的个体出现异常反应。

And when that agent ran over and kicked over the sofa...
说出这话的员工跑过去一脚踢开了沙发……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Ah... Ahh...!
呃……啊！

Miss Aeng-du!
樱桃女士！

... There was Aeng-du, her arms tightly wrapped around Bamboo-hatted Kim.
那后面是正紧紧抱着金笠的樱桃。

Her hand, holding a blade that dug deep into her mentor's flesh.
她手中的短剑，深深地刺进了他的胸口。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
I... know not of your painful past. I cannot possibly know in detail what you have gone through.
您……有着多么痛苦的过去，我无权得知。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
But... But...! That cannot be a just reason, an excuse for cutting down your very own fellows...!
但是，但是！那绝非能够斩杀友人的理由……！

Miss Aeng-du! That man was not himself!
樱桃女士！他失去了自我！

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
If the blade has consumed my mentor, turned him into a fiend... then I will end him myself... it has to be me...
若是他已身堕饿鬼之道，心失所向，那更应该由我的双手亲自了结……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... No. Not at all.
不，不对。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
It's all... excuses. That's all it is.
其实这些，都是借口。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
If mentor didn't bring some odd 'invitation' to us...
说到底……如果不是头领拿来那个奇怪的邀请函……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
If he hadn't caused us to flee S Corp., our home, to begin with...!
说到底，如果他一开始就没让我们逃离S公司……！

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Oh... Yes. I hear you. Your voice is finally... growing clearer...
啊……是。我终于能清楚听见您的声音了……

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Mutation. Distortion of the subject entity confirmed.
变异。确认到接近个体的扭曲。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Suspicion. Phase 1 of the Monolith reactivation process may have been engaged.
推测。独石重新激活，进入第1阶段。

We can't just let her be! She's going to Distort...!
再放任不管的话扭曲又会……！

<Meursault! Knock miss Aeng-du out!>
<默尔索，把樱桃小姐打晕！>

... Hmph!
……哼！

Meursault struck Aeng-du hard before the LCA agents even had the chance to do anything.
在LCA员工采取行动前，默尔索立即让樱桃陷入了昏迷。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
... Stabilized. Distortion nullified by the Subject's loss of consciousness.
……稳定。因接近个体失去意识，扭曲化解除。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Stab wound confirmed on subject T-276-01. Wound not critical. Will not pose challenge to retrieval and recovery.
T-276-01，确认受到刺伤。并非致命部位，可以进行回收与恢复。

I have carried out the task as you have ordered.
已按照您的命令执行。

<Haah... Thank you.>
<啊……谢谢。>

Woah... What just happened...?
哇……刚刚那是什么……？

<Was that caused by the Monolith's influence, too?>
<那也是独石的影响吗？>

A plausible explanation. The Monolith was properly sealed, but its lingering influence seems to have seeped into her.
可以这么说。虽然独石已经被封印，但似乎仍然有残余的影响导致她被侵蚀。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Oh! OH! Hey! The levels went bonkers over there just now!
啊、啊！那个！我刚刚看到那边的数值猛地涨了一下？

The radio began buzzing all on its own again.
切断通讯的对讲机又一次发出声音。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Requesting radio. I will receive LCD's message.
接管。由我接手与LCD的通讯。

<Uh, okay.>
<啊，好。>

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Acknowledged. Please speak.
收到。请说。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Huh? Oh! You're LCA, aren't you? I'm Ezra from LCD, nice to—
嗯？啊！是LCA吧？我是LCD的以斯拉……

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Acknowledged. Commencing sitrep.
收到。进行情况说明。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
You know what? You're not the only one who knows how to cut people off. I already got your 'sitrep', okay? I don't need it.
啊，那我也插一句。我也完全明白情况哦？

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
There are two people there, right? Just bring them both over here.
你那边有两个人吧？把他们俩原封不动地带过来吧。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Negative. Exact orders state that retrieval targets are to be—
拒绝。作战内容中的回收对象为……

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
C'mon, loosen up some, huh~?
别那么死板嘛~

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Concern. The Monolith alone will be a difficult subject to contain.
顾虑。独石本身便难以控制。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Aw~ That's okay. Our very own detecti— I mean, our very own LCD Team Leader said she'll take care of it.
真是的~我们家侦探大人……啊，应该说是LCD的队长，说自己会承担全部责任的啦。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Besides, that Monolith? Detective and I have successfully retrieved that before.
再说那个独石，我和侦探大人以前就成功回收过了。

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
AND, considering that the two of them are both returnees from the Library... considering that the two of them have both been pulled from the edge of Distortion... it'll definitely help us with our records, don't you think?
而且~两人都是图书馆的幸存者~两人都进入过扭曲状态然后被解除，作为扭曲实例而言肯定会派上用场的。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Understood. However—
理解。但……

What the hell? Are we kidnapping them for some dodgy human experiments or something?
什么意思，是要把这俩拐走然后……做人体实验？或者之类的事情？

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Ookay, so I know that there's been scary rumors of kidnappings in T Corp., but... what we're doing here is completely unrelated, alright? I'd appreciate it if you didn't compare us to the likes of those Backstreets rumors.
虽然我知道T公司有不少令人不安的传闻，像什么人被抓走之类的……但我希望你不要把那些失踪事件和我们做的事情关系起来哦？

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Sure, you guys can leave them there. But if we don't take them in, they'll Distort and get killed. And who knows? The Kurokumo Clan or even the Thumb could catch wind of this and pick them up instead.
反正……扭曲到最后他们只有死路一条，直接放着不管的话黑云会或者拇指也会闻讯而来吧？

I suppose you're right...
说是这么说……

dataList.title: LCD
dataList.content:
Anyways... Make sure to bring them in! Both. Of. Them. Okay~?
总而言之，两·个·人·都·要好好地带过来哦~

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
... Acknowledged. Retrieving now.
……收到。即将进行回收。

The call dropped. The agents swarmed around the pair, bound them, and disappeared out the door. All of it was done in one, fluid, practiced motion.
切断通讯后，那名员工抬头示意，其他员工便驾轻就熟地将两人捆着带了出去，转眼间便消失不见。

I don't know when it happened, but they'd already retrieved the Monolith when that LCA agent picked up LCD's call.
虽然我没留意，但独石似乎也在他们进行通讯的时候就被带走了。

Right, so... mission accomplished, huh?
那这算是……任务完成？

<I guess so.>
<应该是吧。>

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Warning. Recommended action for the manager: immediate extraction from the scene.
Imminent arrival of the Thumb: highly likely.
警告。要求执行经理立即撤退。拇指即将掌握情况并赶来现场。

So, after the Middle is the Thumb. Heh, what I wouldn't give to see the look on their stuck-up faces.
中指之后又是拇指吗。呵，我挺好奇那些老家伙会是什么表情。

I think he's telling us to get out of here before the Thumb catches us red-handed...
就是为了不让我们这么做才警告的……

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Correction. Limbus Company was already on a crash course against the Thumb the moment we commenced this mission.
更正。自进行本次作战起，边狱公司就只能与拇指敌对。

... That makes sense. It'll only be a matter of time before they put the pieces together and realize that we're involved in what happened.
……说的也对。他们早晚会察觉到真相吧。

Are you sure that we can handle not only the Middle... but also the Thumb?
真的没问题吗？现在甚至对拇指出手了。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
... Irrelevant.
……无关。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
A foe is a friend, and a friend is a foe for Limbus Company.
毕竟边狱公司现在正处在以友为敌，以敌为友的局面。

dataList.title: LCA
dataList.content:
Delayed. Extracting scene first.
延误。先行离去。

With that cryptic message, the LCA agent quickly withdrew from the scene.
LCA员工留下模棱两可的话后离开了。

He knows something, but won't tell us what it is. At least that was the impression I got from the way he spoke.
……就像是知道什么，却不能说出口一样。

I came to meet so many departments of the company in such quick succession—the LCA, the LCD, and the LCCA...
转眼间，我们与LCA、LCD、LCCA以及众多公司其他部门接触过了。

An old question arose once again. Something I'd forgotten as we kept ourselves busy with the missions we've carried out so far.
曾经在脑海中徘徊过的想法再度浮现。

I really don't know much about this company I'm working for.
我对这公司的了解，仍然只是冰山一角。

And there's this mysterious 'Hermann', and the equally puzzling 'Demian'.
除此之外，还有令人捉摸不透的赫尔曼，以及德米安。

Maybe, in the grand scheme of things, I really don't know anything. Maybe what I know amounts to nothing more than a pinch of knowledge available to the powers that be.
也许在这个难以捉摸的巨大故事中，我所掌握的只是一点点微不足道的情报。

I thought we were pretty deep into our journey, but...
即使我自认为和罪人们的旅程已经度过许久……

I was starting to feel that, in the far future, if I were to look back on the records of this journey... we wouldn't even be ten pages into the book.
我莫名觉得，当我在遥远的将来提笔写下有关这段旅程的回忆时，也许尚未超过十页。

I began walking back to the bus with the Sinners, my head further mired in confusion.
带着脑海中愈加繁杂的思绪，我和罪人们一同走向巴士。

Whewie, we really ran into a lot of people in such a short time, huh?
哎，感觉这么短的时间里碰到了不少人呢。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
Well, I'm pretty happy that I got to know more about the workings of this company.
尽管如此，我认为对这家公司大概的运营方式有所了解是好事。

Once we returned to the bus, the Sinners each began chattering away about what had just happened.
回到巴士后，罪人们谈论起这一系列遭遇。

... I wonder what's going to happen to Aeng-du or Bamboo-hatted Kim?
……樱桃小姐和金笠先生之后会怎么样呢？

That does not appear to be information we are privy to. Though we all work under the same company, all that the LCD shared with us was the name of our contact: 'Ezra'.
那不是我们该知道的。即便任职于同一家公司，我们也仅仅是知道那位“以斯拉”的声音而已。

T-then, is Limbus Company truly kidnapping people for human experi—
难、难道真的是人体实……

... You don't just start experimenting on humans like that. It's not something that just happens. Remember what that LCD woman said? Rumors are just that: rumors.
……这种事不是说做就能做的。那个人不都说了谣言只是谣言而已吗。

Gregor furrowed his brows as though some unpleasant memories of the past began flooding in. He dug into his pockets for a cigarette.
也许是想起了曾经的回忆，格里高尔皱着眉头拿出香烟。

<... There's LCD, but LCA just seems... really out of place. Even when compared to other departments... It's like they're from a completely different company.>
<……除开LCD，LCA这个部门似乎完全不一样。就好像只有他们来自别的公司似的……>

As we made our way back to the bus, I slowly began to organize my thoughts on everything that's happened.
我一边走着，一边尝试整理脑中复杂的思绪。

I did know that it wasn't the most productive thing for me to do.
但我也明白……这没有多大作用。

<... Faust, you're not gonna answer any of my questions, are you?>
<你不会回答吧，浮士德？>

I apologize. At the present moment, it is difficult for me to disclose any information that does not concern the LCB department.
……十分抱歉。目前很难说明LCB部门以外的内容。

<Haah...>
<哈啊……>

It's like impatience is a prerequisite for boarding this bus, manager or Sinner.
看样子不管是经理还是罪人，都得靠焦躁当车票啊。

Vergilius sighed as he muttered. He must've seen me burying my (clock)head in my palms.
维吉里乌斯看到抱着头的我，叹了口气说道。

Your journey will inevitably lead to the answers to all of your questions, Dante.
在你的旅途中一定能找到疑问的答案，但丁。

Just follow the path, and it shall all be revealed. You have no reason to rush.
一切都会水到渠成，有必要急于一时吗？

Besides...
……以及。

Vergilius' gaze fixed, for a brief moment, slightly above my head.
维吉里乌斯的目光看向稍稍高于我头顶的地方。

... I wonder if he's looking at my flame.
应该是在看那团摇曳的火焰吧。

... It's nothing.
……没什么。

Hah, perhaps your impatience is rubbing off on me. I suppose I shall find out along the way as well.
哈，也许我也渐渐变得焦躁了。只要走下去，总有一天会明白的吧。

Vergilius scoffed, muttered something incomprehensible to himself, then turned away from me. It was clear that he had no intention of continuing this exchange.
维吉里乌斯轻笑一声，说了些莫名其妙的话，随后像是没有话题了一样转身走向座位。

Let's go, Charon.
出发吧，卡戎。

Been waiting for vroom-vroom time.
久等了，布隆布隆时间。

Driving to the famous heights of T Corp.
目标是，T公司知名的山丘。

So...
于是乎。

... the bus took off once again, sometimes bustling, sometimes dead silent.
伴随着喧嚣与沉默，巴士的车轮又一次滚滚向前。
